# MaskLab

> A browser tool that fills the individual regions of a vector shape — or the individual glyphs of typed text — with different user-supplied textures, live, with per-region transform control and lossless PNG/SVG/JSON export. A yin-yang saved as one compound SVG path has no separately selectable fills; MaskLab solves that generally. It runs entirely client-side: no backend, no upload, no account.

Built for flags, stickers, and album covers — heavy forms with photographic or generative texture running through them. Shapes come from built-in templates, an uploaded SVG, or typed text (every glyph becomes its own fillable region, horizontal or vertical CJK layout). React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + Zustand, Canvas 2D and hand-assembled SVG, AGPL v3 with a commercial option.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/0xjitsu/zucity_aesthetics/blob/main/README.md): What MaskLab is, quick start, gesture and keyboard tables, template list, tech stack, licensing.
- [How to use](https://github.com/0xjitsu/zucity_aesthetics/blob/main/docs/how-to-use.md): Task-shaped walkthrough — texture into a shape, texture into text, vertical Japanese, uploading your own SVG or font, adjusting a texture, and which export to use for what.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/0xjitsu/zucity_aesthetics/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): Data flow from file to pixels, the canvas/SVG parity contract, the undo and gesture model, how text becomes a template, and the places parity genuinely breaks.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/0xjitsu/zucity_aesthetics/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Codebase map for AI coding agents — invariants with their reasons, task recipes, per-file ownership, verification commands, and known sharp edges.

## Key source

- [src/lib/geometry.ts](https://github.com/0xjitsu/zucity_aesthetics/blob/main/src/lib/geometry.ts): `fillTransform()`, the single source of truth for texture placement. Both renderers derive from it, which is why PNG and SVG agree.
- [src/lib/render.ts](https://github.com/0xjitsu/zucity_aesthetics/blob/main/src/lib/render.ts): `renderComposition()`, shared by the live editor and the PNG exporter.
- [src/lib/svgExport.ts](https://github.com/0xjitsu/zucity_aesthetics/blob/main/src/lib/svgExport.ts): Vector document assembly, one clip path per region.
- [src/lib/textTemplate.ts](https://github.com/0xjitsu/zucity_aesthetics/blob/main/src/lib/textTemplate.ts): Typed text to a template via opentype.js; glyph outlines lowered to path data.
- [src/lib/svgImport.ts](https://github.com/0xjitsu/zucity_aesthetics/blob/main/src/lib/svgImport.ts): An uploaded SVG becomes a template, one region per primitive.
- [src/lib/ingest.ts](https://github.com/0xjitsu/zucity_aesthetics/blob/main/src/lib/ingest.ts): Image decode pipeline, format matrix, and error surface.
- [src/types.ts](https://github.com/0xjitsu/zucity_aesthetics/blob/main/src/types.ts): The whole data model — Region, Template, Fill, Asset, Composition, TextSpec, FontAsset, MaskLabFile.
- [src/store.ts](https://github.com/0xjitsu/zucity_aesthetics/blob/main/src/store.ts): Zustand state, 30-step undo, and the gesture/history contract.
